title: Detect cron problems when run results are written

migration.reservation_basis: Inspected target worktree with migrations/0034_inbox.sql present and 0035 absent before adding the cron migration.

change_inventory.change: Adds model-free SQL classification from committed cron_runs status/error; emits cron_problem lane_events transactionally for new problems; implements OMON_CRON_WATCH_ENABLED with default true; excludes a missed occurrence when a run started inside its scheduled occurrence window.

Uses the coordinator-owned super::health import once; awaits health handling synchronously after committed terminal results and lease reclaim, and performs one startup missed-occurrence scan before spawning the scheduler loop. Health errors are logged without changing committed cron outcomes; catch-up missed writes are synchronous. Delivery failure is passed as a typed execution-path flag, not classified from error prose.
Adds cron_problems with unique (job_id, kind, signature), lifecycle status constraint, optional lane_key and timestamps.

Adds in-memory scheduler/fake-executor fixtures for failed outcome, delivery failure, stuck reclaim, expected-output mismatch and recovery, no-expect success, health DB errors, startup missed idempotence, and a late-started run negative case. Adds an isolated subprocess kill-switch test that runs the actual scheduler with OMON_CRON_WATCH_ENABLED=false and asserts committed failed run plus zero problem/event rows. Fixtures were not compiled or executed.
